description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named EmployeeTrackerSearchFilterParams used within the OrangeHRM performance module. It extends a base FilterParams class and specifies filter parameters for searching employee trackers, including sorting options, employee inclusion criteria, and filtering by tracker IDs and employee number.

classes.name: EmployeeTrackerSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for filtering employee tracker search results with parameters such as tracker IDs, employee number, inclusion criteria, and sorting options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params with default sort field 'tracker.modifiedDate' and sort order descending.

methods.name: getTrackerIds
methods.description: Returns the array of tracker IDs to filter by.

methods.name: setTrackerIds
methods.description: Sets the tracker IDs for filtering.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the current setting for employee inclusion filtering.
